notes: The page does not state pay, dates or deadlines. Confirm pay and current dates with Sociedad Latina.
name: Sociedad Latina Youth Leaders
what_you_do: Join a year-round afterschool and summer program. Roles named on the page include Youth Community Organizer, Health Educators en Accion, and environmental and food justice work. Young people lead awareness campaigns and workshops.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 18 for the three main programs (per the Civic Engagement page).
pay_detail: Listed on the Youth Employment page. Pay amount not stated.
deadline_text: The Youth Employment page says to join the school-year program and click to apply. No dates posted.
how_to_apply: Use the application link on the Youth Employment page (school-year Youth Leader program).
